title: 第29章 吃我一矛
novel_title: 我有一个黑暗密武世界
content_zh:
陈峰心头一跳。

    只见往南的街道上，一个身影正从雾中冲出来。

    是个十五六岁的少女，身高约莫一米六出头，扎着马尾，身上穿着一件灰色的粗布短衣，脚上是黑色的布靴。

    左臂上有一道长长的血痕，鲜血已经浸透了半边衣袖。

    而在她身后十来米，还有另一个身影紧追不舍。

    那是一个二十来岁的青年男子，身材精壮，穿着一件皮甲背心，右手提着一柄短弯刀，动作迅猛。

    单从身形速度来看，两人的实力应该都在淬体中期往上。

    “路昭昭！还是把赤生灵草交出来吧！”

    那青年冷笑着说道，声音在空旷冰冷的街道上回荡。

    而前方的少女咬紧牙关，头也不回的开口骂道：

    “去你娘，沈川！进了猎狗队，你就是个猪狗不如的东西！”

    那个叫沈川的青年冷哼一声，右手猛的一扬，手里的一道飞镖飚射而出。

    锋利的金属镖刃旋转着划破空气，直奔少女后背而去。

    少女身形一变，上半身猛的一拧，腰脊弯出一个如同游蛇般的弧度，轻而易举的躲开飞镖。

    陈峰目光微凝，

    这个躲闪姿势，是蛇杀术第四式·蛇蜕！

    这个少女也是蛇脊流的武者？！

    而且从这个速度和身手来看，应该至少是已经【开阀】的武者？

    陈峰心中微动，这个少女有蛇脊流的开阀法门？

    但他还是下意识的想要避开，不想惹事。

    可这条马路宽阔空旷，除了路边一些低矮的废墟，根本无处可躲。

    而且他现在似乎也已经被发现了。

    前方被追杀的少女看到远处的陈峰，也是微微一愣，脚步出现了一瞬间的迟疑，似乎在犹豫要不要调转方向。

    然而就是这一瞬间的迟疑，给了后方的青年机会！

    沈川右臂暴起，手中的短弯刀脱手飞出，刀身旋转破空声尖锐，在半空中划过一道弧线，劈在少女的右腿外侧！

    “噗——！”

    一声闷响。

    少女闷哼一声，身体失去平衡，整个人向前甩出去。

    重重的摔在地面上，朝前滑了好几米，最后停在陈峰前方不远处。

    “哼，跑啊？我让你跑！”

    那青年沈川咧嘴冷笑，讥讽的看着地上的少女。

    他心中快意。

    以前这路昭昭仗着有一个开阀二境的姐姐，总爱管他的闲事，干些什么锄强扶弱的蠢事。

    什么狗屁的公平正义。

    这些东西自从一百年前那场大灾变到来的时候，就早已不存在了！

    如今这个世界只有一种正义，那就是弱肉强食。

    强者就是要把弱者吃干抹净！

    现在路昭昭姐姐重病，而自己却加入了凶名赫赫的西郊猎狗队，地位高涨，实力精进，自然该是自己向这路昭昭报仇的时候了。

    沈川心中愉悦的想着，上前两步，视线微微上移，这才注意到前方的陈峰。

    “嗯？”

    他微微一愣，随即眯起眼眸仔细打量起陈峰身上的装扮来。

    奇怪而精致的面具和头盔，还有这身光滑的衣服和长靴……
content_en:
Chen Feng's heart skipped a beat.

I saw a figure rushing out of the fog on the street to the south.

She is a girl of fifteen or sixteen years old, about 1.6 meters tall, with a ponytail, wearing a gray coarse cloth jacket and black cloth boots on her feet.

There was a long blood mark on his left arm, and the blood had soaked half of his sleeve.

And about ten meters behind her, there was another figure chasing after her.

It was a young man in his twenties, with a strong build, wearing a leather vest, holding a short scimitar in his right hand, and he moved quickly.

Judging from their body shape and speed alone, the strength of both of them should be in the middle stage of body tempering.

"Lu Zhaozhao! It's better to hand over the Red Life Spirit Grass!"

The young man said with a sneer, his voice echoing in the empty and cold streets.

The girl in front gritted her teeth and cursed without looking back:

"Go to hell with your mother, Shen Chuan! If you join the hunting dog team, you will be worse than a pig or a dog!"

The young man named Shen Chuan snorted coldly, raised his right hand fiercely, and shot out a dart from his hand.

The sharp metal dart blade spun and cut through the air, heading straight for the girl's back.

The girl's body shape changed, her upper body twisted sharply, her waist curved like a snake, and she easily dodged the darts.

Chen Feng's eyes narrowed slightly,

This dodge posture is the fourth form of snake killing technique - snake shedding!

Is this girl also a warrior of the Snake Ridge style?!

And judging from this speed and skill, he should be at least a warrior who has [opened the valve]?

Chen Feng's heart moved slightly. This girl has the secret to opening the valve of Snake Spinal Flow?

But he still subconsciously wanted to avoid it and didn't want to cause trouble.

But the road was wide and empty, and except for some low ruins on the roadside, there was nowhere to hide.

And he seems to have been discovered now.

The girl who was being chased in front was slightly startled when she saw Chen Feng in the distance. There was a moment of hesitation in her steps, as if she was hesitating whether to change direction.

However, it was this moment of hesitation that gave the young people at the back an opportunity!

Shen Chuan raised his right arm, and the scimitar in his hand flew out. The blade rotated with a sharp sound, drew an arc in mid-air, and struck the outside of the girl's right leg!

"Pfft——!"

There was a muffled sound.

The girl groaned, lost her balance, and was thrown forward.

He fell heavily to the ground, slid forward for several meters, and finally stopped not far in front of Chen Feng.

"Huh, run? I'll let you run!"

The young man Shen Chuan grinned and looked at the girl on the ground sarcastically.

He felt happy.

In the past, Lu Zhaozhao relied on a sister who was a master of the second realm. She always liked to meddle in his business and did stupid things like hoeing the strong and supporting the weak.

What bullshit fairness and justice.

These things have long ceased to exist since the great catastrophe a hundred years ago!

There is only one kind of justice in this world today, and that is the law of the jungle.

The strong one wants to eat up the weak ones!

Now that Lu Zhaozhao's sister is seriously ill, and he has joined the notorious Western Suburbs Hound Dogs, his status has risen and his strength has improved, so naturally it is time for him to take revenge on Lu Zhaozhao.

Shen Chuan thought happily, took two steps forward, moved his eyes slightly upward, and then noticed Chen Feng in front of him.

"Huh?"

He was stunned for a moment, then narrowed his eyes and carefully looked at Chen Feng's outfit.

Strange and exquisite masks and helmets, and this sleek clothes and boots...
